name: Agricultural and food product exemptions from IEEPA reciprocal tariffs (Executive Order 14360, November 14, 2025)
notes: EO 14360 (signed November 14, 2025, effective November 13, 2025) exempts certain agricultural and food products from IEEPA reciprocal tariffs.
Modifies Annex II to EO 14257 (April 2, 2025) by adding new subdivision (v)(iii)(a) to U.S. note 2 to subchapter III of chapter 99 of the HTSUS.
237 subheadings added under heading 9903.01.32 via subdivision (v)(iii)(a) — full subheading exemptions applying to ALL countries.

11 additional subheadings added under new heading 9903.02.78 via subdivision (v)(iii)(b) — partial exemptions marked 'Ex'; apply only to specific product descriptions (e.g., 'for religious purposes only', specific tropical fruits).

Section 122 proclamation (Proclamation 11012, Feb 20, 2026) replaced IEEPA duties; these exemptions were carried forward. Goods exempt from IEEPA reciprocal tariffs are also exempt from the Section 122 surcharge.
Codes marked 'Ex' in codes_partial cover only the portion of the subheading described in the proclamation.

codes_partial.note: These 11 subheadings are partially exempt under heading 9903.02.78 (subdivision (v)(iii)(b)). Only the described portion is exempt — verify against the proclamation description before applying 0% rate.
codes_partial.08119080: Tropical fruit, nesoi, frozen, whether or not previously steamed or boiled
codes_partial.14049090: Date palm branches, Myrtus branches or other vegetable material, for religious purposes only
codes_partial.19059010: Bread, pastry, cakes, biscuits and similar baked products, nesoi, and puddings, for religious purposes only
codes_partial.19059090: Bakers' wares, communion wafers, sealing wafers, rice paper and similar products, nesoi, for religious purposes only
codes_partial.20093160: Citrus juice of any single citrus fruit (other than orange, grapefruit or lime), Brix ≤ 20, concentrated, unfermented, except lemon juice
codes_partial.20098970: Coconut water or juice of acai
codes_partial.20099040: Coconut water juice blends, not from concentrate, packaged for retail sale
codes_partial.21069099: Acai preparations for the manufacture of beverages
codes_partial.33012951: Essential oils other than those of citrus fruit, nesoi, for religious purposes only
